ext_dns_page_desc: Domains whose DNS is managed at an external provider instead of PowerDNS. Connect a domain from its DNS records page.
ext_dns_zone_ref_hint: Defaults to the domain. Enter a different zone id or name only if your provider requires it.
ext_dns_no_bindings_desc: Open a domain in the DNS Manager and choose Connect External DNS to manage its records via Hetzner or another provider.
ext_dns_external_note: These records are managed externally via
ext_dns_keep_blank: Leave blank to keep the current value.
ext_dns_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect external DNS for this domain? The records themselves stay at the provider.
ext_dns_sync_confirm: Push this domain's PowerDNS records into the external provider? A/AAAA/CNAME/MX/TXT records are added; SOA and NS are skipped.
ext_dns_setup_hetzner: Open the Hetzner DNS console to create an API token
ext_dns_provider_hetzner_help: Manage records in a Hetzner DNS zone. Create an API token in the Hetzner Console.
